column1: # Members of the `play` profile in addition to every member of `fixed` (decision G30, 2026-11-03: the port diverges from the original on
# purpose; `play` is the app default, `fixed` stays hangs and faults only, `original` stays every switch at 1 and the test oracle).
# Columns as re/port/defect_profiles.tsv: switch value decision_id reason. A switch listed here must not also be in defect_profiles.tsv.

column4: reason
sinScaled interpolates index 255 towards the dword after g_sinTable (never written, 0): it uses entry 255 itself, a flat last segment (model_defects #10)
the 10-entry shot power cache key leaves out the putt argument, so a putt can return a full-shot result: a putt bypasses the cache (model_defects #18)
the strict-scan flag is never cleared within a target search, so once set every later landing is scanned strict: it is cleared before each landing's test (model_defects #37)
the hazard cell passed to the golfer thoughts is y * 50 + x against the grids' x * 50 + y: it is passed in grid order (model_defects #38)
two missed-shot exits skip restoring the named golfer's skill mask: it is restored on those exits too (model_defects #39)
g_namedStoryIndex stored as the 50-byte story id 2k of the opening file k (its readers' unit), not the 0x64-byte slot number k
a theme .pro golfer's ten skill bytes and their sum go into its own pro record, not the next one
cash stored into the int16 month history and ledger entry is saturated to -32768..32767 instead of wrapping
opening the financial report no longer writes each drawn year's column sum into the saved ledger row
per-tile thought counters g_tileMoodUp / g_tileMoodDown saturate at 255 instead of wrapping to 0
the par re-derivation walks hole records 1..18 once each instead of one record 18 times
no free walker record: spawn nothing instead of writing over g_editQueueX
at most 32 ball screen points appended
corner level stops at 0 / 255 and the key-0x58 reset writes all 51 bytes
story cache text cut to the 0x100-byte field
name and third text cut to their stack slots
bulletin event id of 22 or more ignored
the title menu's exit is selected only inside its own 0x3a x 0x39 icon, not over the 0x140 x 0x50 nearest-point area around the icon's corner
the theme-pack screen draws no sixth column cell (the original draws one at a stack word it never writes: a yellow cell left of the list on the current theme's row)
Gary Golf follows the cursor tile only up to the 50 x 50 grid's edge (the cursor tile is clamped for his walk target) and no walker's step leaves the grid
a golfer's walking step is clamped to the 50 x 50 grid, so no golfer (Gary Golf included) walks past the edge of the land

every camera writer that follows a golfer, walker, ball or photo, or offsets from a hole or object, clamps the camera tile to 0..0x31 like the arrow-key and edge-pan cases, so the view centre stays on the map

the HUD panels (build palette, terrain toolbar, buildings, amenities, employee and golfer panels) draw a hovered control's tip after more than 3 frames on it (about 0.37 s) instead of more than 10 (about 1.0 s): the original's `cmp [g_ui_5aa554], 0xa` at 0x00433257 / 0x004338ff and the same compare in the five other panels

the Build palette's tool tip box ends under its content (description, then the horizontal meter 8 rows under the lower of the text's end and the vertical meter's base) instead of a fixed 0x70-row box at row 0x192 whose bottom and horizontal meter (row 0x1ea) the palette covers: showInfoCursorPanel 0x00433280 / 0x0043328a / 0x0043364e

worldToScreen's on-screen test (playSoundAt's RNG draw, the story advances of golfers on screen) covers the host's wide view (W = window width * 600 / height, the view block's word): the same share of the view as the original's 800 of its own, centred; the original tests 800 only

tileToScreen's x window (the tiles whose scenery buildSceneSprites queues) covers the wide view the same way, so the side columns get their trees and objects; the original queues only x -0x40 .. 0x35f

the title menu starts each pass with no item selected, not item 1 (Start New Game), until the cursor nears an item (ML+0x11a95..ML+0x11aad): no item is lit on the first frame and a click away from every item starts nothing
a labelled title-menu item is chosen only with the cursor inside its button art box (showTitleScreen 0x0043d054..0x0043d129), not within distance 0xa0 of its text centre (ML+0x11aaf..ML+0x11ae1)
Esc on the world map acts as its Back button (hot 3: 0x00470634); the original never reads the key words there
Esc on the buy-land screen acts as Done (0x004592e7); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the character editor acts as a press on Exit (case 19, 0x00439d8f..0x00439dba); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the editor's look picker acts as its cancel (a right click: 0x0043857d)
Esc on a popup without key handling (flag4 0: Preferences, the tournament par list; 0x0046db31 skips the key block) acts as its close button (0x0046dcdf -> 0x0046dd86)
Esc in the skill point dialog acts as a click on OK (0x0045f644; the points-left popup when points remain)

a press the widescreen host marked as made where a moved HUD panel used to be (the course shows there; view block word +4) takes the frame's world path (0x0041e4b8) instead of the System menu / panel tests (0x0041e400..0x0041e4b2)

Ctrl+Z undoes the newest course edit step (the edits of one left press): every setGrids edit (0x0040a130) is journalled with the code / refund it overwrote, and the host's undo request (view block word +8) runs demolishObject (0x0040a4e0, the original's right-click undo: previous content back, price refunded) on the step's tiles, newest first, then restores each tile's earlier record; Ctrl+Y builds the newest undone step again through the terrain-tool click path (mainLoop ML+0x10907..ML+0x113b9, H2_Terrain) at the current price; a placed object (H2_Build, ML+0xfd9e..ML+0x106b9) is undone through clearObjectFootprint (0x0040e400, no popup) with exactly the charge its placement took back into the cash, the facilities row and the total dword, and redone through H2_Build at the current price

at the furthest zoom (g_zoomScale 1) the tile pass draws the type class 0xd trees too (the zoom gate 0x0041407a / 0x00414081 skips them there), queued while the sprite queue has room for the entries queued after the tile pass

zooming in goes one level past 4 to g_zoomScale 8 (key 0x7a and the radial zoom-in button double the zoom while it is below 8 instead of 4, 0x0041c932); the golfer shade, the object phrase label, Terrain::setZoomLevel, the terrain strip update and rebuildTileData take zoom 8 as described at g_defect_zoom_in_max4

a held build tool or selection keeps every g_zoomScale (P4_queueAndSelection stores 4 every frame while one is held, 0x00415bcb..0x00415be6 = ML+0x660b..ML+0x6626) and key 0x78 never drops it (it drops both tool words at 0x0041c91e / 0x0041c923 = ML+0xd35e / ML+0xd363); P11E for zoom 8, P13A for 1 and 2: their clicks and previews are linear in the zoom, the translucent tile box is drawn at (z, z, 4) and the translucent sprites take their offsets at the display scale there
the arrow keys (ML+0xe971..ML+0xea73) move the camera 2 tiles at g_zoomScale 8 instead of 4 (the screen distance 4 tiles cover at zoom 4); the edge scroll keeps 1 tile per frame

the golfer and ball labels choose g_font51b360 over g_fontRef_519fd8 by g_zoomScale > 4 (ML+0x71b7, ML+0x7518, ML+0x7aa8); at the zoom 8 of mainLoop.zoomInStopsAt4 = 0 they keep zoom 4's face g_fontRef_519fd8

Cancel in the character editor (case 18, 0x00439d74..0x00439d8a: the type record copied back, then the release wait with the done word unset) also puts back the phrase lines, the golfer skill bytes, the player skills and the portrait slot counters, and leaves the editor without the preference writes of Exit

the first unmoved-camera frame after the terrain is initialised or repainted from scratch runs rebuildTileData over the whole map (rows and columns from 0) and draws one full render; the original syncs the Terrain tiles (types, heights, walls, paths) only after a course edit (rebuildHeightfield clears bit 1 of g_tileWallMask[0]), so its first placement changes river banks and ponds far from the placed object

drawPanelBackdrop's tip bar (drawMapLine, colour 0x80000000, the terrain view's line only, which a 2D screen never shows: U-1071) is also filled into the 2D target under the white tip text while the character editor is open, so the editor's tips (the original's kTips: Load / Save character, the body and look controls, Gender, Cancel, Exit) read over its light art; the in-game HUD tips, whose line shows, are unchanged

a right click on the course with a terrain tool held (Ph_0041ecbb, button word 2, ML+0xfbac = 0x0041f16c) drops the tool when the right-click undo has nothing to act on at that tile (blocked, a 0x8000 tile, or no placed object and g_tileBuildCode 0xff: demolishObject 0x0040a4e0 tests); on any other tile, and with no tool held, the original marks / undoes the tile (an object tool is dropped by the original itself, ML+0xfbe3 = 0x0041f1a3)

key 0x68 ('h') opens the hole being built also in panel mode 3, which updateGolfers sets while the player's golfer waits for its shot (updateGolfers+0x35c2), when openHole 0x0040e720 would open it (tee and green set, the second tee when g_flags bit 6 asks for it, par byte 0); the original there sets g_playerShotStyle = 3 (ML+0xd119..ML+0xd124 = 0x0041c6d9..0x0041c6e4) and the hole stays shut

a fairway / firm fairway tile (types 2 / 3) whose Terrain rotation (the exe's g_tileVariant, 12 + orientation % 12 for a painted tile, H2_Terrain ML+0x10fdd / ML+0x1108b = 0x0042059d / 0x0042064b; Tab adds 1 to the orientation, ML+0xd42a..ML+0xd438 = 0x0041c9ea..0x0041c9f8) has an odd orientation is drawn by Tile::render with the texture coordinates of the next view on every face (each fairway piece's border is the same on all four sides, so it stays in place): its mowing stripes turned 90 degrees; Terrain.dll reads the rotation only for the sand trap, the green and water

the Build palettes' Undo button (the bulldozer: clickSlotPanel slot 0x15, the terrain toolbar's and building palette's -3, the amenities' items 7 / 8, all showing the help string 0x004c7ec4) toggles the game's dormant bulldoze mode, bit 27 of g_flags, instead (a left click then runs demolishObject 0x0040a4e0 on the cursor tile, Ph_0041ecbb ML+0xf6fb = 0x0041ecbb; P6_ToolLabel draws its cursor and label, ML+0xa657..ML+0xa746); a right click on the course clears it too, and the tips name it Bulldoze

rootWin_onKey (an arrow's WM_KEYDOWN: a key with no character, onKey(0, vk)) also keeps the arrow (0x25..0x28) in the held-key word g_char83821c (written by rootWin_onChar for character keys, cleared by rootWin_onChar0 on every WM_KEYUP, read by no code of the exe); while it holds an arrow, a frame whose key code (setDirtyFlagA's take of gDirtyFlagA, ML+0xcb1d = 0x0041c0dd) is 0 takes that arrow, so the camera steps once per frame from the press to the release; the original steps on the press and then only once Windows' key repeat begins after its delay
